description: Angular component for displaying and managing configured features in the Thingsboard UI, including responsive layout adjustments and user permissions handling.

classes.name: ConfiguredFeaturesComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending PageComponent, responsible for displaying configured features with responsive layout and user permission checks.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes layout based on breakpoints, subscribes to breakpoint changes, and fetches features info if user is SYS_ADMIN.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from breakpoint observer to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: featureTooltip
methods.description: Returns localized tooltip text based on whether a feature is configured.
